report.notes: git_control_digest now includes _user_git_control(): effective system/global git config entries (includes followed) plus the bytes of ~/.gitconfig, XDG git config/attributes/ignore, /etc/gitconfig, /etc/gitattributes, git-var-reported GIT_CONFIG_*/GIT_ATTR_* paths, and the effective core.attributesFile/core.excludesFile. It is checked by the existing control_drift before every step and around repairs, so a worker-written insteadOf or smudge filter blocks as TAMPER before checkouts or the push. New tests: test_r4_01_user_level_git_control_files_are_bound (6 params), test_r4_01_included_global_config_and_custom_attributes_file_are_bound, test_r4_01_worker_written_global_insteadof_blocks_and_push_is_not_redirected, test_r4_01_worker_written_global_smudge_filter_blocks_before_checkouts_differ. All 9 fail on 475533a and pass after the change. The pre-existing test_r4_01_relaxed_ws_frozen_check_list_blocks_as_config_change also matches -k r4_01 and passes on both. Full tests/dev_workflow: 174 passed. Detection, not isolation: hostile user config already present at PLAN is accepted as the starting state, as with repo config. Push verification against a PLAN-recorded remote URL was not added. Runs planned with the old digest will see one GIT_CONTROL mismatch that needs an owner unblock. graphify update not run (graphify-out/ is outside permitted paths).
